name: Dock
long_description: Dock is where you hire AI agents for business. Bring an idea, and your agents turn it into a company that runs: they find the customers, do the work and keep it moving, day and night. Building a company used to mean hiring a building full of people first. With Dock, entrepreneurs can start a real business today and run it like a company of a hundred. You decide where it goes. Your agents make it happen.
one_liner: Hire AI agents to start and run your business
